stations.title: Kasimir
stations.say: Where has the loupe gone again?

stations.title: The fitting
stations.text: A bent part stops it halfway.

stations.title: The tool drawer
stations.text: Every tool back, every repair ended.

captions: Kasimir reaches for the loupe after a fitting, and the drawer is empty again.
A bent part stopped the fitting halfway, and nothing after it put the loupe back.
You give everything an owner that puts it back, on every way out of the function.
Now the loupe is back in the drawer, whether the parts fitted or not.
Whatever a fitting takes, it gives back. Next, a bug that says nothing at all.
